editorial:
Ever feel like you are missing a piece of yourself? That is exactly where you start with this strange and dreamy story. You follow a young girl who is wandering through life feeling empty, searching for a version of herself she cannot quite remember. The vibe is very soft and mysterious, almost like a long dream where things do not always make sense at first. It is not your typical loud movie; instead, it focuses on feelings and the weird connection between two people who happen to be the same person in different ways.

What really works here is the acting and the way the movie looks. It is slow, but it keeps you curious about how the two versions of the girl will finally meet. Some might find the pace a bit too relaxed, but if you like stories that make you think about life, you will love it. Since the visuals are so important to the mood, you should definitely try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best experience. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great call so you can appreciate every detail.
endingExplained: At the end, you find out that the two girls are actually the same soul split across different times or planes of existence. They finally come face to face, realizing that their search for each other was actually a journey to become whole again. Once they embrace and accept one another, they merge back into one single person. This fixes the emptiness they felt and allows the girl to finally move forward in life with peace.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves artistic stories about identity and magic realism.
